- Can legal review MSA and surface high-risk clauses (IP, data residency, liability) by EOD Tuesday (4/20)?
- Ops (Kim) — can you confirm hosting residency note on Exhibit B and whether the standard 30-day data deletion clause needs an exception?
- Sales (Marissa) — confirm final seat counts and billing contact so we can populate Order Form.

1) Legal quick heatmap (high/medium/low) — due 4/20 noon PT
2) Collate redline pack for counterparty — 4/20 afternoon
3) Walkthrough call w/ procurement (Eclipse) — propose 4/21 10:00 PT

Attachments: Eclipse_MSA_Draft_20270417.docx (draft MSA), OrderForm_Eclipse_Q2_v3.xlsx (seats/pricing workbook).

Thanks — Riley

Thanks Riley + Ari — I’ll own the legal heatmap and proposed redlines. Below is my intake summary and owner matrix so we have clear handoffs. Forwarding to the group for visibility.

Intake summary (high level):
- Contract type: Standard Redwood MSA + Order Form (volume-based seats).
- Primary external: Eclipse Systems (Ari Goldberg, procurement).
- Commercial sensitivity: moderate — discounts applied for committed volume; finance will want a clean Order Form for PO ingestion.

Priority clauses (initial triage):
1) Liability / cap / indemnities — HIGH (legal)
2) Data residency / cross-border transfer — HIGH (ops + legal)
3) Audit & security evidence (SOC 2) — MEDIUM (security ops)
4) Data deletion / retention window — MEDIUM (ops)
5) IP carveouts / use-of-output rights — MEDIUM (legal)
6) SLA & uptime credits — LOW (commercial)

Owner matrix (who will draft/comment):
- Legal (me, jonas_weber) — liability, IP, SLA, indemnities (heatmap + redline).
- Ops (kimberly_park) — residency, data deletion, exhibit B notes, hosting footprint.
- Sales (marissa_cole) — pricing, seat count confirmation, who signs.
- Security (cc’ed to security later if needed) — SOC 2 evidence ask + any encryption/KMS details.

Deliverables & timeline:
- Legal heatmap (document listing clause + risk + proposed position) — deliver by 2027-04-20 12:00 PT.
- Collated redline packet (.docx + summary PDF for procurement) — 2027-04-20 17:00 PT.
- Walkthrough call w/ Eclipse — confirm 2027-04-21 10:00 PT; Riley to send calendar invite.

Links: draft clause sheet (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleShareLink
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/DEAL-4862

Attachments referenced: Eclipse_MSA_Draft_20270417.docx, OrderForm_Eclipse_Q2_v3.xlsx

Action items (quick):
- Kim: confirm whether Exhibit B requires a residency carveout before EOD 4/19.
- Marissa: confirm final headcount and billing contact (finance@eclipse-sys.com).
- Riley: please prepare the procurement PDF export if possible; else I’ll convert the final packet.

Jonas Weber
Senior Counsel, Contracts

Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: initial redline priority, owners, and review timeline

Jonas — quick update from ops:
- Exhibit B currently lists multi-region but our standard deployment for this product line is US-East primary with passive replication to US-West. We can mark primary residency as US-East and include a short note that replicated logs may cross regions (standard operational detail).
- Data deletion: our default 30-day deletion on ephemeral logs is fine; persistent customer datasets are 90 days by default. Eclipse asked for 180 days — we can offer 90 with a committed retention addendum (ops-approved) but would need a billing uplift.

I’ll attach a short Exhibit B markup and a suggested retention addendum stub.

Attachments: ExhibitB_markup.pdf (stub), Retention_Addendum_Suggested.docx

Kimberly Park
Head of Operations, Hosting
kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
